## Exact application contract

Each backend and mode needs a separate fresh build and Instance. Default mode0
checks actual ABI value1 and opens only `joint-state`, requiring actual errno13
and no returned managed handle/owner. A startup/link failure, idle11, local
quota90, unsupported95, invalid22 or disconnected107 is a failure. Any unexpected
successful open remains in its real Session ledger and is closed before failure
is reported. Backend enablement and permission are different facts.

Explicit mode1 requires only one independently granted `topic.subscribe` alias
`joint-state`; its actual resource, complete official native type/identity,
canonical codec identity, QoS, connection and finite bounds belong to the trusted
Host. The Guest grants none of them. It subscribes once, consumes one actual
binary stdin `R` credit before each poll, polls at most64 times and stops at its
first complete value. A normally returned11 is idle; any other error or thrown
decoder/callback exception fails. No timer, queue drain, thread, background
callback, reopen, resize-and-replay, clock/environment/preopen grant, native
library fallback or management/debug/update authority is added.

The decoder checks complete framing, strict UTF-8, counts/bounds, finite numbers,
normalized time, optional-equal-length JointState semantics and trailing input.
The application independently compares **every field** with the unchanged
`observer-fixture.json`: ROS1 seq19/sec42/nsec300000000; ROS2 signed sec-2 and
nanosec300000000 with no nonexistent seq; frame_id `base`; names `left`,`right`;
position [1.25,-2.5]; velocity length0; effort [0.5,-0.25]. Exact binary fractions
need no tolerance. The bound is only the actual generated public MAX, within
the existing32768 lesson ceiling; no hand-computed native or wire bound is used.

Success is printed only after actual Session closure returned and every cleanup
result was checked. `PASS_JOINT_STATE_DEFAULT_DENIED` or
`PASS_JOINT_STATE_FULL_VALUE` is a Guest-level assertion, not a native delivery
or vendor qualification. Original primary exceptions and separate cleanup
diagnostics remain reachable through the retained Session plus the lesson's
diagnostic fields. Known pre-entry failed closes remain visible and make
success impossible; attempted/unknown closes are never replayed. Java retains
its cleanup lists and separate exception; C# keeps `CleanupReport.Primary`,
items, cleanup exception and actual `LastSetupCleanup` via `LastSession`; Python
keeps Cleanup, last factory frame and original Session. A fatal trap, process
kill, stack failure or unrecoverable OOM cannot promise managed finally execution:
the real external Runtime/Instance/process owner is still mandatory.

## Explicit planner extension

`adapter_plan.plan(..., read=actual_reader)` keeps its historical six-language
behavior. A trusted caller may explicitly add `managed=selection`, containing
only languages, actual optional generation/output full7s, an exact SDK/lesson
source full7 map and per-language producer source/receipt/inventory full7s.
The existing actual bound catalog/native registry/source binding is still
required before the extension runs. The extension reopens real selected bytes,
compares the complete optional/native record closure and bounds/identities,
checks the existing generator's fixed output names, selected foundation pins
and C# source mapping, then binds the entire selected source/output bundle.
It only supports this JointState telemetry lesson, its literal alias and at
most64 credits. Unknown languages, service/action shortcuts, null/mismatched
generation association, partial output sets or missing source dependencies
are refused. No existing emitter is called or modified.

Producer dependency receipts/inventories are bound as **actual source-plan input
bytes**, not treated as an execution authority or a complete compiler link
qualification. The future owned producer must still verify actual selected
tools, sysroot/archive/classpath/native object/link dependencies, final Wasm and
all actual imports. New returned fields retain zero actual compiles/Guest runs/
native deliveries and no authority. No public SDK type/operation ABI changes.

All eventual dynamic generation, build, Guest/native tests and performance
measurements must run only in the existing SSH Linux64GiB zero-swap cgroup,
under its admitted owner/resource/disk/cleanup rules. An independent actual
native publisher must set and publish all fixture fields after genuine source,
native type/default/identity/Gateway qualification. Default denial also needs
external no-endpoint/no-queue evidence. Ordinary prior93/DBG30 or generic
language/codec results do not qualify these new lessons, Threads, vendor
hardware or unchanged performance. The dated Java checkpoint above covers only
its listed actual compiler/codec/default-disabled paths and makes no positive
native or performance claim.
